title: Maintainer action: create the repository wiki's first page, so the weekly Platform Checklist Status can publish (red every Monday since 10-05)
body:
**Filing gate ①**, as `tooling`: a scheduled workflow is red on `main` on every run, measured, and only the maintainer can clear it. Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, on the maintainer's 「立一张维护者卡片」. ⛔ Not a claim.

Maintainer-action: create the repository wiki's first page once (any content), then run the `Platform Checklist Status` workflow once. Done when that run is green and the index page `Platform-Checklist` exists.

## 维护者速读

- **要做的事（两步，约 2 分钟）：**
  1. 打开 https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/wiki ，点 **Create the first page**，标题和内容随便填（例如标题 `Home`，内容 `Platform wiki`），点 **Save page**。
  2. 打开 https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/workflows/checklist-status.yml ，点 **Run workflow**（分支 `main`）。几分钟后它会生成 `Platform-Checklist` 索引页，以及每个领域一个 `Checklist-<area>` 页。
- **为什么只能你来做：** GitHub 的 Wiki 在建出第一页之前，没有可以克隆的 git 仓库，所以工作流里的 `git clone …wiki.git` 必然失败。建第一页只能在网页上操作，席位没有这个权限。
- **不做的后果：** 只是状态页一直不更新，每周一的定时运行一直红。checklist 的执行和运行记录本身不受影响，因为状态页只是把 `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` 渲染成网页。
- **之后：** 每周一 03:37 UTC 自动刷新。你也可以随时手动 Run workflow。

## Measured (read in this act)

- The repository has `has_wiki: true`: the Wiki feature is on, and it has no pages yet.
- `Platform Checklist Status` (`.github/workflows/checklist-status.yml`, cron `37 3 * * 1` plus `workflow_dispatch`) concluded `failure` on its last three scheduled runs: 2026-10-05, 2026-10-12 and 2026-10-19 (run `39196614051`).
- The publish step clones `https://github.com/<repo>.wiki.git` first. On failure it prints its own remedy: "the wiki must exist before it can be written to. Open the repository's Wiki tab and create the first page once (any content); every run after that overwrites the generated pages."
- The step deletes and rewrites only the pages it owns (`Platform-Checklist.md` and `Checklist-*.md`). The hand-made first page stays as written.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md:350` already links the index at `https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/wiki/Platform-Checklist`, which 404s until this is done.

## Dedupe

No open or closed card names the wiki first page. A title search for `wiki` / `Checklist Status` since 2026-10-01 returned none. The step had been carried only as a line in the triage round records (R496 onward).
